title: Robotmancer
description: Feeling lonely in your battles? No problem! Become a Robotmancer today and summon powerful robotic allies to help you in the fight!
body:
# Robotmancer

Is a combat-focused mod that grants players the ability to summon powerful, loyal robots to fight by their side. Tired of companions who disappear? Your robotic allies are persistent and fierce!

Key Feature: Your summoned robots are permanent additions to your world. They do not despawn with time and will only leave the battlefield when they are defeated (killed).

Dominate any challenge in your Minecraft world!
